name: bld5_prime_three_mod_four_dvd_lucas
statement: (p : ℕ) (hp : p.Prime) (h : p % 4 = 3) : ∃ n : ℕ, p ∣ p3_lucas n
closed: ∀ (p : ℕ) (hp : p.Prime) (h : p % 4 = 3), ∃ n : ℕ, p ∣ p3_lucas n
informal: Uses Mathlib2.bld3_pisano_pos_and_period and Mathlib2.nt2_fib_odd_index_no_prime_factor_three_mod_four: bld3_pisano_pos_and_period at i = 0 gives some k > 0 with p ∣ F_k; take the least such a (Nat.find). The nt2 theorem (no prime ≡ 3 mod 4 divides an odd-indexed Fibonacci number) forces a even, a = 2n with 0 < n < a. Nat.fib_two_mul gives F_{2n} = F_n·L_n (the factor 2F_{n+1} − F_n is p3_lucas n by definition); p ∤ F_n by minimality, so p ∣ L_n.
type: ∀ (p : ℕ), Nat.Prime p → p % 4 = 3 → ∃ n, p ∣ Mathlib2.p3_lucas n
